title: Spyglass: Ready for Everyone
summary: We are thrilled to announce the official launch of Spyglass, now fully available to empower all users with its powerful features after a successful beta.

title: Powerful File Management in the Editor
summary: Users can now seamlessly upload, manage, and customize the visual presentation of their files directly within the editor, granting comprehensive control over their content.

title: Discover Our Product Roadmap
summary: We've launched a new roadmap page to give you full transparency into our past achievements, current priorities, and future plans.

title: Effortless Checkboxes
summary: We've made checkboxes bigger, easier to click, and fully draggable, all while updating their look to seamlessly integrate with your experience.

title: Real-Time Collaboration Improvements
summary: Elevating your team's productivity, our enhanced editor now offers a more intuitive and seamless real-time collaboration experience.

title: Improved Discovery of Shared Content
summary: Discovering and collaborating on shared content with your connections is now more intuitive, ensuring all relevant items are easily accessible whenever you need them.

title: Global Language Support
summary: We are thrilled to bring Noeko to a global audience by introducing comprehensive support for a wide range of international languages.

title: Noeko Goes Open Source
summary: We are open-sourcing Noeko to empower our community with greater control, foster direct involvement in its growth, and enhance transparency.

title: Dynamic Constellation Insights
summary: Unlock deeper insights and streamline your workflows with an enhanced Constellation view, featuring powerful filtering by tags, time, and shared items.

title: Advanced Search & Custom Collections
summary: Effortlessly find and organize your information with powerful new filters and the ability to save your customized search results as personalized collections.

title: Flexible Note Layouts
summary: Organize your thoughts more effectively with new, flexible display modes that provide richer previews and interactions for your connected notes.

title: Noeko: Empowering You with Self-Hosting and Flexible Plans
summary: Soon, you can choose to self-host Noeko for complete control or select a flexible cloud-hosted plan with premium features, designed to scale with your needs.

title: Elevate Your Workspace with Fresh Themes
summary: Get ready to transform your workspace with beautifully refined existing themes and an exciting array of brand-new visual options designed to suit every preference.

title: Enhanced Time-Aware Greetings
summary: We're enhancing your homepage experience with more accurate time-based greetings, ensuring you always receive a perfectly timed welcome, day or night.

title: Seamless Tag Organization
summary: Effortlessly manage your tagged content with new bulk actions, allowing you to quickly unapply tags and streamline your workflow directly from any tag view.

title: Expand Your Sources
summary: Effortlessly bring in information from a wider variety of content types, including videos, websites, and text, directly into your personal knowledge base.
